name: HTTP ( {request} )
purpose: Generic HTTP client module: from a JSON request (url, method, headers, query, data, basic auth) it builds a cURL command, calls Insert from URL, and returns a JSON with status, code, response headers and body.
open_question: secret: step 98 builds "-u user:password" from the request auth and step 135 stores the whole cURL option string, password included, in the session variable $$lastCurlOptions. Certificate verification is off (VerifySSLCertificates false). The script exits with an empty result when the request is empty.
